method: Cross-author read-only review of changed harness/profile, workflow/gate tests, contract and owned freeze/supervisor. Procedural PASS was verified before content review. Parent explicitly released frozen implementation files for review; remaining active claims include subsequent measurements/delivery.
excluded: Author-owned production schema.rs/schema_selection.rs changes and their tests; their independent review belongs to selector_tests.
verified_source_properties: New three-case profile is separate from historical command profiles. Canonical plans bind case, trial, fixture, role and namespace; both baseline and candidate require the same qualified native probe.

Common-harness baseline overlays exactly schema.rs and schema_selection.rs from the registered baseline. Native codec and guard stay identical. Freeze saves both binaries, restores candidate source under an exit trap and checks source hashes.

Per five-trial shard:45 sessions/90 seed-update transfers,30 actual fits,540MiB object payload and596.3515625MiB conservative storage bound. Local dose180 and WAN dose540 are consistent with plan generation, canonical validation and workflow registration.

Selector setup performs the unchanged corpus generation, references, real fit, exact frozen-artifact comparison, context construction and temporary cleanup inside the timed scope. Whole pays its context setup. No fit amortization or hidden base seed is assumed.

Operation timers include preparation, hashing, serialization and durable acknowledgement. Sender process CPU and receiver handler CPU are disjoint; exchange is nested. Lifecycle adds setup/seed/update once; staged profile timings are attribution only.

Main summary joins exact case/trial/role pairs, verifies complete counts and stopped-store byte comparisons, and requires identical baseline/candidate selection receipts and normalized winner frames. Actual mode-dependent decoder-cache statistics are checked.

Local gates use exactly ten random-1m setup ratios at0.80, ten zero-control prepare ratios at0.95 and ten random-1m update sender ratios at1.05. The control driver preserves all zero,period64 and deceptive-gap observations and permits only truthful proof-to-completed-Whole receipt changes.

Workflow gates exact source/ref/attempt1, validated six HTTPS origins and dedicated capability. Credentials are not persisted by checkout; token is limited to the transfer step and not printed. Actions are SHA-pinned, permissions read-only, execution sequential and bounded, and failures are retained without retry.

Owned supervisor binds loopback receivers to scoped plans, keeps its process alive, tracks child PIDs, and cleans up owned children on exit. Verification precedes owned cache removal; failed stores remain.
limitations: No Cargo/check/Clippy/test/profile/benchmark was rerun; the sealed procedural qualification supplies those receipts. No production implementation was modified by this review.
This review checks measurement implementation and gate joins; it is not an independent recomputation of every local measurement row and does not claim a WAN result.

Network metric is request+response HTTP body bytes, excluding transport headers,retransmissions and relay hops. Exchange elapsed is not pure wire time. Receiver CPU covers handlers, not all socket/logging/relay work; energy is unmeasured.
Receiver executable hash remains operator-supplied rather than remote attestation. Parent owns the final composite local-gate release and actual WAN launch.
Native compression proof and author-owned fit/scheduler correctness are outside this cross-author approval.
